% 29.01.2026 Crl.M.A. 2939/2026 & Crl.M.A. 2940/2026 (exemption)

1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 481/2016 of Police Station Najafgarh for offence under Section 498A/34 IPC on the ground that the respondent no. 2 has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned APP accepts notice and submits that prosecution has no objection to this petition.
4. Respondent no. 2, identified by IO/SI Pankaj, accepts notice.
5. For recording statement of parties, list before Joint Registrar concerned on 27.03.2026.
